<style scoped>
:where(#tv) {
  --white: #c1c8c7;
  --black: #1b173b;
  --blue: #1a254c;
  --light-blue: #1a4369;
  --dark-blue: #2a2345;
  --metallic-blue: #3e567a;
  --wenge: #684a60;
  --brown: #9f777c;
  --dark-brown: #433754;
  --gray: #acb6c0;
  --light-gray: #717a92;
  --dark-gray: #617b99;
}

#tv {
  width: 360px;
  height: 314px;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: 
    /* Control Buttons */
    radial-gradient(var(--metallic-blue) 21px, transparent 22px) 224px 159px /
      44px 44px,
    radial-gradient(var(--metallic-blue) 21px, transparent 22px) 224px 106px /
      44px 44px,
    /* Sound Output */
      repeating-linear-gradient(var(--black) 0 4px, var(--dark-brown) 4px 10px)
      217px 212px / 56px 64px,
    /* Screen Section */
      linear-gradient(to right, var(--dark-blue) 200px, var(--dark-brown) 200px)
      14px 90px / 262px 194px,
    /* Body */ linear-gradient(to right, var(--wenge) 290px, var(--brown) 290px)
      left 74px / 360px 226px,
    /* Antenna */
      linear-gradient(to right, var(--blue) 62px, var(--light-blue) 62px) 208px
      64px / 76px 12px,
    linear-gradient(
        -60deg,
        transparent 50%,
        var(--dark-gray) calc(50% + 1px) 60%,
        transparent calc(60% + 1px)
      )
      250px top / 54px 74px,
    linear-gradient(
        60deg,
        transparent 50%,
        var(--dark-gray) calc(50% + 1px) 60%,
        transparent calc(60% + 1px)
      )
      180px top / 54px 74px,
    /* Bottom Section */
      linear-gradient(to right, var(--blue) 252px, var(--light-blue) 252px) 18px
      bottom / 326px 20px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

#tv::before,
#tv::after {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
}

#tv::before {
  width: 180px;
  height: 174px;
  top: 100px;
  left: 24px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: radial-gradient(var(--white) 65%, transparent calc(65% + 1px))
    center -30px / 340px 118px no-repeat;
  background-color: var(--gray);
  box-shadow: inset 6px 0 var(--dark-gray);
}

#tv::after {
  width: 44px;
  height: 98px;
  left: 224px;
  top: 105px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        transparent 40%,
        var(--light-gray) calc(40% + 1px) 54%,
        var(--gray) calc(54% + 1px) 60%,
        transparent calc(60% + 1px)
      )
      left bottom / 44px 44px,
    radial-gradient(var(--blue) 21px, transparent 22px) left bottom / 44px 44px,
    linear-gradient(
        30deg,
        transparent 40%,
        var(--light-gray) calc(40% + 1px) 54%,
        var(--gray) calc(54% + 1px) 60%,
        transparent calc(60% + 1px)
      )
      left top / 44px 44px,
    radial-gradient(var(--blue) 21px, transparent 22px) left top / 44px 44px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  mask-image:
    radial-gradient(var(--black) 16px, transparent 17px),
    radial-gradient(circle, var(--black) 16px, transparent 17px);
  -webkit-mask-image:
    radial-gradient(var(--black) 16px, transparent 17px),
    radial-gradient(circle, var(--black) 16px, transparent 17px);
  mask-position:
    left top,
    left bottom;
  -webkit-mask-position:
    left top,
    left bottom;
  mask-size: 44px 44px;
  -webkit-mask-size: 44px 44px;
  mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
}
</style>
